evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:236-254 — pokemonCards(refs, extra) absorbs each caller's variation (hiddenAbility, types) without flag parameters

abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions track the app's real variation (cards, types, sections) and stretch well; a new resource page must copy the metadata/404 boilerplate rather than reuse it.

findings.issue: The filter URL query (q/type/generation) is serialized here and again in pageHref in app/src/app/page.tsx:19-27; adding or renaming a filter parameter requires editing both in sync, and a mismatch breaks pagination or filter restoration.
findings.suggestion: Export a single buildFilterHref(values, page?) (or shared param keys) from one module and use it in both the client filters and server pagination links.

findings.issue: Default-variety resolution (species.varieties → is_default → Pokémon id) is duplicated in loadSpecies and loadTeam (app/src/app/team/page.tsx:40-42), and pokemonCards (api.ts:240) resolves Pokémon→species a third way, by id only.
findings.suggestion: Add a lib/api.ts helper like getDefaultPokemon(species) (and a species-ref lookup) so the mapping lives in one place — this is exactly the seam a Deoxys-style sprite fix needs.

findings.issue: CardData.id is the species id in getSpeciesIndex and loadTeam but the Pokémon id in pokemonCards (api.ts:240-250); the type is ambiguous about which, which is the latent root of a wrong-sprite/dex-number bug.
findings.suggestion: Document (or rename to speciesId and resolve it inside pokemonCards via the existing species list) so every card constructor agrees on semantics.

findings.issue: loadTeam builds its own English-name map from getAllTypes instead of reusing getTypeLabels (api.ts:189), duplicating label logic.
findings.suggestion: Call getTypeLabels() and drop the local map.

findings.issue: The resource-page skeleton (cache() loader, generateMetadata with 'Not found', await connection(), notFound) is copy-pasted across the four detail routes with no shared helper, so each new resource (e.g. Items) re-copies it.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small withResourcePage or loadResource helper (loader + metadata factory) in lib, or accept the duplication consciously as framework idiom.

findings.issue: The 'sync controlled state when the server value changes' pattern (prev-state pair) is hand-rolled here, in filters.tsx:31-38 and partially in team-toggle.tsx:22-25; fixing a bug in it means three edits.
findings.suggestion: Extract a useSyncedServerValue(value) hook in components and reuse it.

findings.issue: Types are enumerated and labeled per page (getAllTypes + englishName at app/types/page.tsx:10, app/page.tsx:35, app/team/page.tsx:28, pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:63); fine today, but each new type-taking page re-derives labels.
findings.suggestion: Consider a single cached allTypes-with-labels accessor that pages share.

findings.issue: Slot-sorted type mapping (sort by slot, then typeInfo) is duplicated in app/src/app/team/page.tsx:46-47.
findings.suggestion: Add a toTypeInfo(pokemon.types, labels) helper in lib/api.ts.

summary: A cleanly layered app where data access, formatting, and card rendering each funnel through single modules, so most changes and removals touch one or two files. The recurring cost is triplicated micro-logic: URL query serialization, default-Pokémon resolution, and controlled-state syncing from server props. Server/client boundaries and team-state handling are exemplary for a feature bolted onto an existing app.
